messages:
Priya (Customer Success): Hey team — escalated issue from ACME: SCIM group changes are not consistently updating roles. They say when they remove users from the 'Contractors-Engineering' group some users keep the developer role and others are removed. They included SCIM payloads and our request/response logs. Can someone look?

Liam (SRE): Do we have the raw SCIM patch the IdP sent and our corresponding processing log? Need to know whether we returned non-200 or dropped the op.

Priya (Customer Success): Pasting redacted snippet from the customer's Okta webhook + our inbound logs. Note the members entry: they send a member with only display (email) and no `value` id. Our processor appears to accept 200 but no role change occurs.

```
PATCH /Groups/00g7abcde123 HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/scim+json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op":"remove","path":"members[value eq \"2819c223-7f76-453a-919d-413861904646\"]"},
    {"op":"add","value": {"members": [{"display":"julia@acme.com"}]}}
  ]
}

--- our inbound handler log (redacted) ---
2026-03-11T14:22:03Z INFO  scim-handler Received PATCH group 00g7abcde123
2026-03-11T14:22:03Z DEBUG scim-handler op[remove] members.value=2819c223-...
2026-03-11T14:22:03Z DEBUG scim-handler op[add] members.display=julia@acme.com
2026-03-11T14:22:03Z INFO  role-mapper add: lookup by member.value -> not found for display-only entry
2026-03-11T14:22:03Z INFO  scim-handler Responding 200 OK
```

Priya (Customer Success): Customer says they used the same Okta config for other apps and those vendors map by email when value is missing. They expect removal/add to affect role membership.

Noah (Identity Eng): Thanks, this is ringing a bell. Root cause hypothesis: our SCIM group handler currently only reconciles member add/remove ops when the member entry has a `value` (the SCIM user id). If `value` is absent and only `display` is present, we don't attempt an email lookup and so we silently skip role reconciliation. IdPs like Okta sometimes send display-only members when they can't/choose not to include the internal id.

Noah (Identity Eng): Repro steps I used locally:
1) Send PATCH with add member as `{"display":"test+scim@acme.com"}`
2) Observe op processed but role not assigned.

Noah (Identity Eng): Quick example log from a local run: `role-mapper add: lookup by member.value -> not found; fallback not attempted`. That's our bug.

Liam (SRE): Is there any chance this produced a partial state (e.g., group contains the member but app role not set) that would lead to orphaned privileges? We need to know blast radius before running any fix.

Noah (Identity Eng): Yes — partial state is exactly what customer's seeing. Group object in SCIM DB shows member list updated (we reflect whatever the IdP sends) but the role assignment layer requires a successful user lookup to attach role principals. For display-only members we currently no-op. So some users (created earlier with value ids) reconcile fine; others (added via Okta where only display was sent) end up without the role.

Noah (Identity Eng): Fix plan (low-risk): modify SCIM parser to, on member entries that lack `value`, attempt to resolve the user by `externalId` and then by `display` (email). If user exists, proceed with role add/remove flow. If not found, keep current behavior but log metric and return 200 as before.

Noah (Identity Eng): Patch diff roughly: in scim/group_parser.go -> in processMember(member) add fallback `if member.Value == "" { user = findByExternalID(member.Display) || findByEmail(member.Display) }`. Unit tests + e2e. Drop-in change, small risk.

Priya (Customer Success): Is this something we can hotfix and run a reconcile job for the affected tenant? Customer is on Dedicated but wants timeline.

Noah (Identity Eng): Yes. Timeline estimate: 1 dev day to implement + tests, 0.5 day code review, 1 day deploy + smoke. After deploy we need a one-off reconcile job that will introspect all groups for that tenant and for display-only members try to reconcile. We should run reconcile in dry-run first and share results with the customer.

Liam (SRE): What does the reconcile job look like? Can it be scoped to the tenant and run with a dry-run flag? Need to ensure idempotency and low load.

Noah (Identity Eng): Proposed internal API: `POST /internal/scim/reconcile?tenant=acme&dry_run=true` body optional filter `{"group_ids": ["00g7abcde123"]}`. The job will iterate group members and for any member missing `value` attempt lookup by email; if found, call our role-mapper to add/remove role principals. In dry-run it will just emit a report with counts and sample user ids.

Noah (Identity Eng): Minimal SQL to find affected rows for audit:
```
SELECT g.id AS group_id, m.display AS display_email
FROM scim_group_members m
JOIN scim_groups g ON m.group_id = g.id
WHERE m.value IS NULL AND g.tenant = 'acme'
LIMIT 100;
```

Noah (Identity Eng): We should also add a metric `scim.member.fallback_lookup.count` so we can measure frequency.

Priya (Customer Success): Sounds good. Customer asked if we can do this tonight. I'll need an ETA for the reconcile result (dry-run) so I can tell them. Also need to confirm no downtime.

Liam (SRE): No downtime expected. The change is a parser fallback path; will be deployed as usual. Reconcile is read/heavy-check + targeted role calls; we can throttle. For a single tenant with ~5k members it should finish within an hour with throttling.

Noah (Identity Eng): Operational plan:
- Impl + tests: 1 business day.
- Canary deploy (internal) + smoke: 2-3 hours.
- Run dry-run reconcile for tenant: 30-60 min, share report.
- Customer sign-off to execute real reconcile: 30-60 min.

Noah (Identity Eng): Rollback plan: revert commit and re-deploy. Reconcile job is idempotent so if anything weird happens we can re-run after rollback to detect divergence.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll message the customer with this timeline and ask for permission to run the dry-run tonight. If they approve, I'll need the specific tenant id and confirm a 20:00 UTC window.

scim-bot: Job enqueue request accepted: reconcile-dryrun tenant=acme group_filter=[00g7abcde123] requested by priya.cs at 2026-03-11T19:10:21Z

Liam (SRE): @Noah can you add the metric and the reconcile endpoint to the runbook? I can take the reconcile execution once the patch is in canary.

Noah (Identity Eng): Yep. I'll open a PR and add runbook steps + required flags. Assigning myself to the fix. Will ping here with PR link and ETA.

Priya (Customer Success): Thanks — assigning to Noah. I'll coordinate with customer for the 20:00 UTC window and post permission here. :thumbsup:

Liam (SRE): :eyes:

Noah (Identity Eng): PR will target `hotfix/scim-display-fallback`, aim to have it ready by EOD.

Priya (Customer Success): Great. Marking this escalated. I'll follow up after customer confirms dry-run ok.

(END)
